@@ greater_orcs
As a race, Greater Orcs were breed to be very capable o independent and intelligent action. They are much more suited t the formation of societies than are Common Orcs.

@@ hysical_haracter
Build: While Greater Orcs have a more “human” appearance tha Common Orcs, they are still heavy with cat-like eyes, fang teeth, and thick hides. They have longer, stronger, and straighte legs than Common Orcs. Males and females average 14 pounds. Coloring: Black or grey hair, black or reddish-brown eyes, an black/grey hides. Endurance: Tremendous. They can travel for 2 days withou sleep. +30 to exhaustion points (see Section 22.3). Height: Greater Orcs average 5'6". Lifespan: Indefinite; certainly hundreds of years, but the natur of their warlike life permits few to live past the age of 50. Resistance: +30 DB and RR bonuses versus heat and col attacks. Special Abilities: Greater Orcs usually sleep during dayligh hours, although they need sleep only once every 3 days (mor often to restore Power Points). Greater Orcs operate freely i daylight, and their vision in most darkness is as good as a Man’ during the height of day. When there is barely any light (cloud moonless nights; upper caverns, dungeons), Greater Orcs ca see at least 30' perfectly and fairly well up to 75'. In absolut darkness, they can see 10'.

@@ ulture
Clothing & Decoration: Skins, leathers, and metal armor crude, but well made and effective. Fears & Inabilities: They dislike natural sunlight and dee running water, but they do not fear them. Lifestyle: Bred as warriors, Greater Orcs respect power an terror above all things. Marriage Pattern: Greater Orcs do not marry; they breed. Th females are receptive only to the fiercest and most attractiv males. Religion: Most Orcs worship Darkness and power.

@@ ther_actors
Demeanor: Greater Orcs possess more intelligence and cunnin than Common Orcs, but they are still cruel, jealous, pett ambitious, selfish, and suspicious. Language: Starting Languages: Black-speech (S8/W2), Orcis (S8/W3), Common-speech (S5/W2). Allowed Adolescenc Development: Black-speech (S10/W10), Orcish (S10/W10 Common (S8/W8), Wood-speech (S6/W3), Hill-speech (S6 W3). Prejudices: Greater Orcs hate all other races. They particularl despise Elves, who they believe to be a spiteful, wicked, an wayward race. Professions: Most Greater Orcs are Fighters, Rogues, and Thieve they make very poor Essence and Mentalism spell users. Special Skills: Everyman: all skills within one of the followin categories: Weapon • 2 Handed) or Weapon • Polearm; Re stricted: none.
